subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers repair this conflicting branch, or make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 the canonical landing path for the linked provider-error retry bug?
rationale: This branch is now conflicting and proof-thin, while another open candidate is mergeable and proof-positive; choosing the canonical branch and accepting the attempt-result contract is maintainer intent, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Use the mergeable sibling as canonical
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the primary landing path and keep this PR open only until maintainers decide whether any tests or rationale should be preserved.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase this PR, resolve conflicts, and add redacted full-runner or gateway proof before another merge-readiness review.

options.title: Pause both branches for contract review
options.body: Hold all candidate PRs until an owner explicitly accepts the optional current-attempt metadata contract and retry-before-failover semantics.

recommendation.title: Use the mergeable sibling as canonical
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the primary landing path and keep this PR open only until maintainers decide whether any tests or rationale should be preserved.
